reviews.text: This job is done first and foremost for the love of animals, not for business, but the owner only thinks about money, the rest has no love for our family puppies. Honestly, I lost a deposit for the fixed dates, but that earned me the veterinary expenses that he already made me lose in the past, obviously not wanting to take on the responsibility. PS: Before signing the contract when you entrust the dog, read it carefully, apart from the fact that I do not recommend it, there are much better ones and you also spend less. I attach a photo demonstrating the condition of my dog ​​after I picked him up from them.
A beautiful and quiet structure with lots of greenery, the owner is very kind and very helpful.

This was our first time leaving our Dado in a kennel, and after much research, the Bau House seemed like a good fit for both the facility and the price. I didn't get to meet the owner directly because a staff member was there both when we arrived and when we picked him up. Perhaps it was because they were closing times, so we were a little worried at first, but then we received a video and Dado seemed at ease. Perhaps more photos during the stay would have been appreciated, but when he picked up, the dog was happy and in good condition. We will definitely use this facility again, hoping to meet the owner in person.

I took my French bulldog to this property for just three days, and I have nothing bad to say about the staff, who are very kind and helpful. I even left a deposit to book the August stay. Unfortunately, however, my dog ​​developed a health problem, severe gastritis, after staying at their property. The vet explained to me that this is common for bulldogs, as they are delicate dogs and don't always adapt well to these situations.
Consequently, I decided to contact them to cancel the reservation and request a refund of the deposit for the August dates. However, the owner refused to refund me, claiming that their rules prevented it, despite my having given them two months' notice.
Excellent! Reasonable prices and very friendly service. Highly recommended.
We brought our Oliver for 10 days and we are satisfied. They are good people and treat all the furry ones well. I recommend the structure. Thanks for everything...
A largely positive experience. The cat was fine.
Magnificent place, spacious and well-kept with large green spaces... my dog ​​is now at home.... Kind staff and attentive to the needs of our furry friends.... Leo always comes home happy and fit 🥰 …
It's a center that takes exceptional care of your dog. The owner is very kind and helpful, as well as competent.
Thanks to the quality of life

Our Max is a somewhat unusual client, one who puts any dog ​​sitter to the test...but not Bau House!
The facility is tailor-made for our four-legged friends, who are welcomed and cared for with great professionalism, but above all with LOVE, attention, and dedication.
Thanks to BauHouse, if I can't bring Max with me, I'll give him a 5-star vacation!
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
😊😊😊

We left our puppy there during our vacation...everything was perfect...
Thank you so much ☺️
I recommend Bauhouse because it is truly an excellent facility where four-legged guests are cared for with great care and attention!

For 6 years, I've been leaving Gioia periodically, for short and long periods.
I've found her to be very professional and very loving towards animals.
Highly recommended!

Even those who have some animal that is like a brotherly friend when they come to this place it is like being reborn finding tranquility, harmony, nature even a glass of water in that moment seems from a spring of another era
My dog ​​Benjamin has been a guest at Bauhouse for years. He's very happy with it. He's always in great shape. The facility is wonderful.
Excellent facility, safe, clean and familiar environment, where our dogs are treated very well and return happy🥰 …
I left three cats for about two weeks. I was very pleased with the cleanliness and excellent environment for the animals.
excellent structure, kind and professional owner!

And the first time I met Domenico, a friendly person, I immediately liked the place with lots of greenery and care for animals, my lola immediately found the understanding with Domenico and his staff, for me we will bring her back another hundred times, my lola was serene and you could see that she was happy, beautiful, beautiful🐕‍🦺🐕‍🦺🐕‍🦺

Domenico was very prompt in his responses, charges a fair price, and the check-in and check-out process were very easy. He explained everything, was very accommodating and also accepted a last minute reservation. Highly recommended and I plan on using his services again!

I brought my puppy on Friday the 22nd, saying he'd be staying for a week, and also booked a grooming session for €20. It says it was open from 4 to 6 p.m., but when I called to pick him up on Thursday the 28th, I was told it was closed and I had to go in the morning. Well, for this, even though I showed up at 10 a.m., the owner still demanded €20 for the 29th. He's a beggar who played the same trick he did the day before on purpose. Also, I don't know if he can see where and how the dogs are; you'll only see the check-in and check-out. I asked him for videos during the week, and he only sent me two videos of him in the yard, and after many requests (which was the same clipped video)... be wary, and if you don't want to do it, go knowingly. We don't know how the dog was; obviously, he was clean when he picked up and was happy to see us, and fortunately he didn't have anything.
Congratulations to all the staff at Bau House, top location and owner.
I took my dog ​​to the boarding house for a week. I found him in excellent condition, well washed and calm. Thanks to the owner. Positive experience.

My chihuahua doesn't "love" everyone, but she did very well here for a week! I got a funny (to me) video of her standing in the grass (lots of shade! ) watching another dog run around. All dogs seem welcome here, Highly recommend!
Very attentive owner, excellent place for our dogs

Great experience! Reliable staff and reasonable costs.
I left two small dogs for a week with medical needs and care, and I picked them up clean and happy, just as I left them.
I recommend them to anyone in need.

After visiting another boarding kennel to leave my little Leo, which didn't satisfy me at all, in fact it left a bad taste in my mouth... I contacted a friend who gave me Domenico's number, who immediately struck me as a decent, distinguished, and trusting person... so I decided to leave Leo at BauHouse for 11 days (it was my first time)... Domenico kept me updated via videos on how Leo was doing, and I must say I've never seen him so happy. Also because he's a house dog 😬 so he rarely interacts with other dogs... That said, when he came home today, he was also nice and clean and smelled great... but above all, soooo happy to see me! Thank you for everything, you're truly impeccable. I highly recommend this facility. Elisa
